heard: Voyager 1 was only built to last five years. Launched on September 5, 1977, the probe was designed for a short tour of the planets. Voyager 1 found active volcanoes on Io and strange spokes in Saturn's rings. Instead of shutting down, the spacecraft reached interstellar space in 2012 and kept going. Now 15 billion miles away, signals take over 23 hours to travel back to Earth. By 2026, it will finally go dark as its last two instruments fail. Engineers manage this distance using computers with a total memory of only 68 kilobytes. It remains an immortal messenger that continues to defy its original design.
